text.zh: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
text.en: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.

note.zh:
1.States force more people to pay sales tax（各州能强迫更多的人支付购物税）（⚠️是更多的人支付购物税 不是交更多的购物税‼️）
2.when they make online purchases （当他们网上购物的时候）
3.under a Supreme Court decision Thursday（‼️这里的Thursday 前面不需要介词）（在最高法院周四的一项判决下）
4.with lighter wallets（钱包变扁）
note.en: 1.States force more people to pay sales tax (各州能强迫更多的人支付购物税) (⚠️是更多的人支付购物税 不是交更多的购物税‼️) 2.when they make online purchases (当他们网上购物的时候) 3.under a Supreme Court decision Thursday (‼️这里的Thursday 前面不需要介词) (在最高法院周四的一项判决下) 4.with lighter wallets (钱包变扁)
